definitions.explanation: The most severe legal punishment, in which the convicted person is sentenced to death. Japan retains the death penalty, carried out by hanging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{死刑|しけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}された→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: The defendant was sentenced to death.

examples.japanese: {死刑|しけい}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: There is growing demand for the abolition of the death penalty.

examples.japanese: {死刑|しけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: Whether one supports or opposes the death penalty is an issue on which opinions differ by country.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan is one of the few developed countries that retains the death penalty. The topic frequently appears in news and social studies materials. {死刑|しけい}⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧ (execution of the death penalty) is carried out by the Minister of Justice's order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死刑|しけい}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: death sentence
- {死刑|しけい}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: death penalty system
- {死刑|しけい}⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧: execution
- {死刑|しけい}⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧: abolition of the death penalty
- {死刑|しけい}{囚|しゅう}: death row inmate
- {死刑|しけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{求刑|きゅうけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to demand the death penalty (prosecution)
